brand.description: Keep only products whose brand contains this text, for example Milwaukee.
brand.title: Brand (optional)

categoryUrls.description: Home Depot category URLs (/b/...) or browse codes (N-...). Used in category mode.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or Browse Codes

filterKeywords.description: Comma-separated words; keep only products whose title contains at least one, for example chainsaw,chain saw.
filterKeywords.title: Title Keywords (optional)

includeAisleBay.description: Add the aisle and bay where the product sits at the selected store.
includeAisleBay.title: Include Aisle and Bay

includeDetails.description: Add description, specs, key features, UPC/GTIN, all images, videos and variants for every product.
includeDetails.title: Include Product Details

includeQuestions.description: Add customer questions and their answers for every product.
includeQuestions.title: Include Questions & Answers

includeReviews.description: Add customer reviews and the rating breakdown for every product.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

includeSponsored.description: Include paid product placements alongside organic results.
includeSponsored.title: Include Sponsored Products

includeStoreAvailability.description: Add store-local pickup quantity, pickup/delivery split and delivery details.
includeStoreAvailability.title: Include Store Availability

itemIds.description: Home Depot item IDs or product URLs (/p/...). Used in products mode.
itemIds.title: Item IDs or Product URLs

maxItems.description: Overall maximum number of products to save.
maxItems.title: Maximum Products

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum products to save from each search query or category.
maxItemsPerQuery.title: Maximum Products Per Query or Category

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages to read for each search or category. Home Depot returns up to 24 products per page and 30 pages per browse.
maxPages.title: Maximum Pages Per Source

maxQuestionsPerProduct.description: Question cap for each product when questions are enabled.
maxQuestionsPerProduct.title: Maximum Questions Per Product

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Review cap for each product when reviews are enabled.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Maximum Reviews Per Product

minRating.description: Drop products rated below this average, from 0 to 5.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

mode.description: Choose what to scrape: a keyword search, a category browse page, or specific Home Depot item IDs.
mode.title: Mode

onlyClearance.description: Keep only products with a clearance price.
onlyClearance.title: Only Clearance Products

onlyInStock.description: Keep only products available for pickup at the selected store or for delivery.
onlyInStock.title: Only Products In Stock

onlyOnSale.description: Keep only products with a real discount, promotion, special buy or clearance.
onlyOnSale.title: Only Products On Sale

priceMax.description: Only keep products at or below this price.
priceMax.title: Maximum Price (USD)

priceMin.description: Only keep products at or above this price.
priceMin.title: Minimum Price (USD)

reviewsSort.description: How to order reviews when reviews are enabled.
reviewsSort.title: Review Order

searchQueries.description: One keyword per line, for example 'cordless drill'. Used in search mode.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sortBy.description: How to order the products in each search or category.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

storeId.description: Home Depot store number for store-local prices and pickup stock. 121 is Cumberland, GA.
storeId.title: Store ID

zipCode.description: Used to find the nearest store when Store ID is empty, and for delivery estimates.
zipCode.title: ZIP Code (optional)
